latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Recording Editor Online — AI-powered video editing in the cloud.

- Upload raw recordings (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe edit tasks in natural language.
- Automatically trims pauses, removes filler words, adds title cards, overlays, and more with simple prompts.
- Exports to 1080p MP4, ready to download within about a minute for short clips.
- No local software required; all processing and rendering handled on remote GPU nodes.
- Supports multiple file types for upload, and provides real-time status and credits tracking.
- Built-in session and error management, with clear user feedback and tips for optimal results.
